gate.fiasa_closed: The old trolley tracks fade into the fog. There's nothing here yet.
gate.trolley_desert_closed: The desert is not accessible yet. Repair the bus first.
gate.walk_desert_not_repaired: You've only just arrived, looking to leave already? The road through the tunnel is closed until summer.
gate.walk_desert_exhausted: You don't have enough energy for such a long walk. Rest first or take the bus.
gate.central_station_closed: The terminal is currently out of service.
gate.terminal_out_of_service: The terminal is currently out of service.
willy.fiasa_dialogue: Did you see that mist at dawn? By the Old Mariner, something massive was stirring out beyond the rocks... like steel silhouettes along the old tracks.
willy.fiasa_letter: Hey neighbor!^^At dawn today, while checking my nets by the water, I noticed a strange sight through the fog... It looked as if the old abandoned tracks stirred, and lights from an unfamiliar vessel flickered through the mist. Watch your step if you head out that way.^^   - Willy
inke.aquarium_dialogue: Did you hear the news? The bus is fixed, and now you can take a train from Central Station all the way to Stardew Aquarium! You should definitely check it out.
aquarium_quest.title: Reach Stardew Aquarium via Central Station
aquarium_quest.description: With the bus repaired, Central Station is open again. Trains are departing to other regions. Take a train from Central Station and visit Stardew Aquarium.
config.enable_fiasa_gate.desc: If enabled, blocks access to FIASA / Trolley until the arrival date.
config.enable_trolley_desert_gate.desc: If enabled, blocks trolley canyon/desert access until the bus is repaired.
config.enable_walk_desert_gate.desc: If enabled, blocks the tunnel path until first summer.
config.remove_horse_warp.desc: Completely removes the horse path to the desert from the Backwoods.
config.walk_stamina_cost.desc: Energy drained when walking to the desert on foot.
config.walk_drain_return.desc: Whether walking back from the desert also consumes stamina.
config.enable_central_gate.desc: If enabled, Central Station is locked until the bus is repaired.
config.remove_railroad_terminal.desc: Removes the standalone handcar terminal to Grampleton Fields on the Railroad and unifies it with Central Station.
config.enable_qiblade_qigems: Sell Qi Blade for Qi Gems
config.enable_qiblade_qigems.desc: In Mr. Qi's shop in Downtown Zuzu, sell the Qi Blade for Qi Gems instead of offering it for free.
config.qiblade_cost.desc: Amount of Qi Gems required to purchase the Qi Blade.
